text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. told Katsuragi Ace that she had 
kept running this whole time simply to 
enjoy racing against her worthy rival, 
Katsuragi Ace.

However, Katsuragi Ace saw her as nothing 
more than a wall. She was obsessed only 
with overcoming her.

What Katsuragi Ace was looking at wasn't 
victory, but how to overcome it. She 
laments that nothing frustrates her more 
than that right now.

Mr. C.B. declares— that today, she will 
thoroughly beat Katsuragi Ace and see what 
lies beneath that rebellious mask.
